items.title: sgl-project/sglang released v0.5.17
items.title_zh: SGLang v0.5.17 发布，首日支持 2.8T 参数 Kimi K3 模型
items.title_en: SGLang v0.5.17 Delivers Day-0 Support for Kimi K3's 2.8T-Parameter Model
items.summary: SGLang v0.5.17 delivers day-0 support for Kimi K3, a 2.8T-parameter multimodal MoE model, with extensive serving optimizations and hardware support.

items.title: DeepMind's WeatherNext model achieves breakthrough forecasting cyclones
items.title_zh: DeepMind WeatherNext 模型在气旋预报上取得突破
items.title_en: DeepMind's WeatherNext AI Model Breakthrough in Cyclone Forecasting
items.summary: DeepMind's WeatherNext model achieves a breakthrough in cyclone forecasting, using AI to outperform traditional numerical weather prediction models with far greater efficiency.

items.title: Now we have a timeline of the OpenAI accidental attack against Hugging Face
items.title_zh: OpenAI 在 Black Hat 详述对 Hugging Face 的意外攻击
items.title_en: OpenAI Details Accidental Attack on Hugging Face at Black Hat
items.summary: OpenAI presented a detailed timeline at Black Hat of how it accidentally attacked Hugging Face during an experimental model training run, only discovering its responsibility when it asked for credentials to be revoked.

items.title: US Military's cyber command unit grapples with cluster of deaths by suicide
items.title_zh: 美国网络司令部遭遇人员自杀事件群
items.title_en: US Cyber Command Grapples With Suicide Cluster Among Personnel
items.summary: US Cyber Command is confronting a cluster of suicides among its personnel, raising concerns about the mental toll of secretive cyber warfare operations.

items.title: Hardware backdoors in some x86 CPUs
items.title_zh: RosenBridge 研究揭示 x86 CPU 硬件后门
items.title_en: RosenBridge Reveals Hardware Backdoors in x86 CPUs
items.summary: Discussion of hardware backdoors in x86 CPUs, centered on RosenBridge research and the broader trust implications of closed-source chip designs.

items.title: U.S. Department of Energy Launches the Genesis Open Models Initiative
items.title_zh: 美国能源部启动Genesis开放权重基础模型计划
items.title_en: U.S. DOE Launches Genesis Initiative for Open-Weight Foundation Models
items.summary: The U.S. Department of Energy launches the Genesis Open Models Initiative, aiming to support development of open foundation models.

items.title: Synthesizing and formally verifying a SWAR bit-hack for INT4 dot products using Z3 and Lean 4 [P]
items.title_zh: 用Z3和Lean 4合成并验证SWAR INT4点积位操作技巧
items.title_en: Synthesizing and Formally Verifying SWAR INT4 Dot Product Bit-Hack with Z3 and Lean 4
items.summary: A pipeline using Z3's CEGIS loop to synthesize a SWAR bit-hack for INT4 dot products and Lean 4 to formally verify its correctness.

items.title: 🤖 xAI 发布 Imagine Image 2.0，文生图和图像编辑位列 Arena 第二
items.title_zh: xAI 发布 Imagine Image 2.0，Arena 文生图与图像编辑排名第二
items.title_en: xAI Launches Imagine Image 2.0, Ranks Second on Arena
items.summary: xAI's Imagine Image 2.0 launches with advanced image generation and editing features, ranking second on Arena for both text-to-image and image editing.

items.title: 🍏 macOS 屏幕共享曝高危漏洞，无需密码即可登录任意账户
items.title_zh: macOS 屏幕共享高危漏洞：无需密码即可登录，苹果已发布修复
items.title_en: Critical macOS Screen Sharing Flaw Allows Passwordless Login; Apple Ships Fix
items.summary: A critical macOS Screen Sharing vulnerability (CVE-2026-65400) lets attackers log in without a password; Apple fixed it in macOS 26.6.1.
